{"command": "echo "Here is how you can kill VS Code using taskkill:

# Kill all VS Code processes (code.exe)
taskkill /IM code.exe /F

# If you want to also kill child processes (e.g., extensions, webviews):
taskkill /IM code.exe /F /T

# For VS Code Insiders (Code - Insiders.exe):
taskkill /IM "Code - Insiders.exe" /F

# Using PowerShell:
# Stop-Process -Name code -Force

# Or using wmic:
# wmic process where name="code.exe" delete

# If you only want to kill a specific instance, find its PID first:
# tasklist | findstr code.exe
# Then:
# taskkill /PID <pid> /F

# Note: /F forces termination; use with caution.
""}
